Assets.NotesMarkdown:
# Terminal 1.0.99

1. SELL and BUY have a soft glow at the top, a thin darker edge and rounded corners, in the chart strip, the order ticket and the close window. They get a little lighter on hover and darker when pressed. When a button cannot be used it turns into an outline with a light tint.
2. The small arrow on SELL and BUY is a plain white arrow with no dark box behind it. It is a little dimmer and lights up fully for a moment when the price moves.
3. Selected text, and the selected row in a list or drop-down, is blue in every box. The brand accent is no longer used for selection.
4. The start-up window shows the logo mark with the brand name in two colours: the first part in the text colour, the second in the brand accent.
5. When you are offline the bottom-left cell reads "TradeNext FX · Offline" with a grey dot after the words.
6. A drawing you point at or select no longer gets a glowing band along the line. A selected drawing shows its end points and the toolbar; a drawing you point at gets only a slightly thicker line.
7. Drop-down lists, such as the account list on sign-in, close when you click anywhere outside, press Esc, or switch to another window.
8. With a drawing tool and the magnet on (or Ctrl held), the crosshair itself jumps to the nearest open, high, low or close of the candle under it, before you click and also for the first point.
9. The parallel channel works the way you draw it: two clicks for the first line, a third for the width. The second line is a copy of the first, the fill closes on the right corners, and you get a handle on each corner and in the middle of each line.
10. After the last click of a tool, moving the mouse no longer drags the chart. Esc stops any drag, and a missed button release is dropped.
11. Drawings and their labels are cut off at the edge of the chart and no longer paint over the price scale or the time scale.
12. We could not find the large empty blue rectangle on our screens. The selection box of a drawing is now checked to stay the size of the drawing. Send a screenshot if you still see it.
13. RISK % stays empty until a stop loss is set, and the hint about the smallest lot only appears when there is a stop loss and it is true. Changing the symbol clears both.
14. The History footer shows BALANCE (the closing balance only), DEPOSITS, WITHDRAWALS and PROFIT. It shows OPENING only when your period starts after the account was opened, and "OPENED 16 Oct" when the account was opened inside the period.
15. Click a History column header to sort by it: once for ascending, again for descending, a third time for the default (newest on top). The choice is remembered for each account.
16. The new sound set is in. Settings > Notifications now has one Sounds switch and a volume slider; the per-event boxes, PLAY buttons and price-feed switches are gone.
17. Max slippage is gone from Settings, the order ticket and the New order window, and the terminal no longer sends a slippage limit with an order. Your broker's own limit is the only one.
18. Position tags on the chart now use colour for meaning: BUY is blue and SELL is red, and the profit or loss figure is blue for a profit and red for a loss. The lot size and the close cross stay in the normal text colour.
19. On the chart, the line between a position's price and its profit or loss now has proper spacing ("4444.00 · 7.25 USD") instead of running together.
20. Chart labels (position, stop loss, take profit and pending order) now sit on a small background in the chart colour, so they stay readable over a candle of the same colour.
21. The LIMIT and STOP price now follows the market until you type your own; the refresh arrow next to it brings it back. The two hint paragraphs are gone: only the side that does not fit the price is switched off.

22. On the STOP tab the price follows the ask plus your symbol's minimum distance (one point if there is none), so Buy Stop is ready at once. On the LIMIT tab it follows the middle of the spread, or a little below the bid when the minimum distance is wider than the spread.
23. Tooltips now open already finished: the panel colour, border, font and full text are there from the first frame, with no dark box or odd symbols, and a tooltip with no text never opens.
24. Chart toolbar tooltips are plain text in the terminal font, with no special symbols.
25. A one-minute candle that was skipped on the chart is now filled in again, including after the connection comes back.
